taxonomy.NEAR_MATCH_VALUE: Numerically within 5% of a target value while being a different fact -- a plausible-looking wrong answer.
taxonomy.OTHER_SAME_DOMAIN: A real record from the same primary source with no closer relationship to the target.
taxonomy.WRONG_ENTITY: Same metric and period, a different entity (other company, country, trial, product).
taxonomy.WRONG_PERIOD: Same entity and metric, a different period (other year, quarter, or instant).
taxonomy.WRONG_SERIES_VARIANT: Same entity, period, unit and underlying measure, but a different series variant or measurement basis such as seasonal adjustment, frequency, nominal/real basis, or transform.
taxonomy.WRONG_UNIT: Same entity, metric and period, reported in a genuinely different unit.
taxonomy.WRONG_VERSION: Same entity, metric, period and unit, but a different filing/revision/submission version.
